comando: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetFirewallProfile | Format-Table Name,Enabled,DefaultInboundAction -AutoSize; Get-NetConnectionProfile | Format-Table NetworkCategory,IPv4Connectivity -AutoSize; Get-NetFirewallApplicationFilter | Where-Object { $_.Program -like \"*StrategyQuant*\" -or $_.Program -like \"*j64*\" } | ForEach-Object { $r = $_ | Get-NetFirewallRule; \"{0} | {1} | {2} | enabled={3} | {4} | {5}\" -f $r.DisplayName,$r.Direction,$r.Action,$r.Enabled,$r.Profile,$_.Program }"
descripcion: Seguridad: lectura sin cambios de la configuracion de Windows Defender Firewall: perfiles, categoria de red y reglas para programas de SQX (StrategyQuant / j64 Java)

comando: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "netsh advfirewall show allprofiles | Select-String \"Perfil|Profile|Estado|State|Directiva|Policy\"; \"--- reglas con puerto local 5050:\"; Get-NetFirewallPortFilter | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -contains \"5050\" } | Get-NetFirewallRule | Format-Table DisplayName,Direction,Action,Enabled,Profile -AutoSize; \"--- reglas de entrada activas que permiten java o sqcli:\"; Get-NetFirewallApplicationFilter | Where-Object { $_.Program -match \"java|sqcli\" } | ForEach-Object { $r = $_ | Get-NetFirewallRule; if ($r.Enabled -eq \"True\" -and $r.Direction -eq \"Inbound\") { \"{0} | {1} | {2} | {3}\" -f $r.DisplayName,$r.Action,$r.Profile,$_.Program } }; \"--- fin\""
descripcion: Seguridad: politica efectiva de entrada por perfil (netsh, solo lectura) y reglas activas que abran el puerto 5050 o permitan cualquier puerto de entrada a java/sqcli
